name: Asian Kitchen
notes: 4 photos, all menus. 1-2 are the same overhead wall menu board (2 is the wider shot covering more sections); 3-4 are a self-order kiosk screen showing add-on pricing (+) and item photos. Overlapping items (Pad Thai, Drunken Noodle, salad rolls) merged, keeping the wall-board price.

dishes.name: Tonkotsu Ramen
dishes.description: Tonkotsu pork bone broth, fresh egg noodles, pork belly, half ramen egg, fried garlic, yu choy, green onion, and sesame seeds.

dishes.name: Potstickers
dishes.description: Pork & scallion potstickers with ginger-soy dipping sauce.

dishes.name: Pad Thai
dishes.description: Housemade pad thai sauce, rice noodles, bean sprouts, chives, salted turnip, seasoned tofu, egg and peanuts. W/ tofu 17.50, chicken 18.50, shrimp 19.95.

dishes.name: Drunken Noodles
dishes.description: Rice noodles sautéed with chili paste, mustard greens, zucchini, squash, broccoli, thai basil and crispy shallots. W/ tofu 17.95, chicken 18.50, shrimp 19.95.

dishes.name: Pork Belly or Grilled Chicken Bánh Mì
dishes.description: Roasted pork belly or sous vide chicken, hoisin sauce, cucumber, pickled carrots & daikon radish, jalapeño, cilantro, mint, spicy mayonnaise.

dishes.name: Poke Bowl
dishes.description: Sushi rice, red leaf lettuce, furikake, seaweed salad, cucumber salad, carrots, edamame, avocado, crispy shallots. W/ tuna 18.95, spicy tuna 18.95, crab 17.95.

dishes.name: Salad Rolls
dishes.description: Red leaf lettuce, ginger rice noodles, green onion, pickled daikon and carrots, cucumber, mint, and cilantro. Served with sweet chili and peanut sauce. W/ tofu 15.95, chicken 16.50, shrimp 16.95.

dishes.name: Teriyaki Bowl
dishes.description: Carrots, red onions, broccoli florets, sesame seeds, scallions, and teriyaki sauce over steamed jasmine rice. W/ tofu 17.75, chicken 18.75, shrimp 19.75.

dishes.name: Fried Rice
dishes.description: Jasmine rice stir-fried with egg, corn, peas, onions, egg, mirin, tamari and hoisin sauce, topped with green onions, cilantro & lime. W/ tofu 16.25, chicken 16.95, shrimp 17.95, spicy pork belly 17.95.

dishes.name: Stir Fry
dishes.description: Stir-fried zucchini, squash, mushrooms, mustard greens, carrots, and broccoli served with jasmine rice. W/ tofu 17.75, chicken 18.75, shrimp 19.75.

dishes.name: Pad See Ewe
dishes.description: Stir-fried rice noodles with broccoli, egg, and crispy shallots with a sweet soy sauce.

dishes.name: Red Curry
dishes.description: Housemade red curry with sweet potatoes, cauliflower and greens. Served with your choice of chicken, shrimp or tofu.
